# Upstream

`tegaki` is imported from **https://github.com/gkurt/tegaki**.
- Licence: MIT
- Author: gkurt
- Imported: 2026-11-13

A handwriting engine: HarfBuzz shaping, a pressure model, a nib, and glyph drawing for any font. The source is vendored so the capability is in the building; it is **not** wired into a composition yet, and the bundled fonts are not vendored — their licences are separate and they are 25 MB of binaries.

The upstream licence file is included in this directory and applies to every
file here that came from upstream. Anything written for Motion Master itself
and shipped alongside it is licensed separately — see `../../LICENSE.md`.
